chain.hash_input_rule: str values hash as raw utf-8 bytes (bytes-law); all other values hash canon(obj) first

embedded.note: row_hash = h(seal_body); h = fnv1a64(canon(seal_body)) with hex16 lowercase, 0x-prefixed

executor.note: row_hash = fnv1a64_int(canon(seal_body)) formatted %016x; first row prev_hash = genesis (16 zero chars)

constraints.runtime: MicroPython >= 1.20 (no dataclasses, no asyncio, no typing)
constraints.memory: rows append-only; bounded devices should forward segments to a larger cell
constraints.time: tick counter authoritative (chain before/after); wall clock advisory

cross_check: rows booked on ANY substrate verify on every other; the chain is the portable format; a foreign vessel holding only this manifest plus a chain export must be able to verify and extend without importing our code
doctrine: visible refusals: cannot-do books REFUSED with the reason
fallbacks are first-class rows, never silent
the chart must suffice: no hidden knowledge outside this manifest
